title: 36 Hours in Honolulu
abstract: The city brims with summer’s delights, with colorful produce in the market stands and Hawaiian music spilling onto beaches.

title: 36 Hours in Honolulu
abstract: The city brims with summer’s delights: overflowing farmers’ markets and lei stands, and Hawaiian music spilling onto beaches from oceanfront lounges.

title: 36 Hours in Bar Harbor, Me.
abstract: Some resort towns get trendier over the years, but Bar Harbor — a delightful base from which to bike, hike and sail around Maine’s Mount Desert Island — feels deliciously frozen in time.

title: 36 Hours in Bar Harbor, Me.
abstract: This summer resort feels frozen in time.

title: 36 Hours in Aspen
abstract: It’s entirely possible to go high-adrenaline by day and highbrow culture by night in this Colorado mountain town.

title: 36 Hours in Aspen, Colo.
abstract: Summer in Aspen brings fields of wildflowers framed by snow-capped peaks, a festival-rich arts scene, and myriad opportunities to hike, bike and mingle with the glitterati.

title: 36 Hours in Budapest
abstract: A weekend here provides a glimpse of the city’s justifiable pride, as well as an authentic sense of place.

title: 36 Hours in Budapest
abstract: From stately Buda in the west to shabby-chic Pest in the east, the Hungarian capital’s brightest spots are native-born, rather than imports.
